profile.name: Typhos多行文本编辑组件
profile.description: 一个非物理实验软件界面组件，用于通过 PyDM 通道显示、编辑并提交多行文本内容。它可根据通道写权限切换为只读模式，适合在实验控制界面中输入或查看备注、配置文本或其他字符串数据。
profile.description_en: A non-physical laboratory software UI component for displaying, editing, and sending multiline text through PyDM channels. It can switch to read-only mode based on channel write access, making it suitable for entering or viewing notes, configuration text, or other string data in experiment control interfaces.
